selected.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents from directly accessing customer accounts
selected.summary: Weeks after the launch of Meta's Muse AI assistant, Jamie Dimon says JPMorgan Chase is not going to allow outside agents to directly access accounts on behalf of retail customers.
selected.why: Major US bank sets precedent by banning third-party AI agents from directly accessing customer accounts.

reason: JPMorgan's AI access ban tests whether financial regulation should mandate direct account access for AI agents or allow banks to set their own guardrails.
angle: Banks should retain discretion to block third-party AI agents from direct account access rather than regulators requiring interoperability.
